comparators.configuration: Prior hand drafting and mechanically drawn strands
comparators.contrast: Multiple roller pairs turning at different speeds can draw the supplied strand mechanically; no unmeasured output improvement is asserted.

cases.limits: The 1738 Paul patent described differential roller pairs and an alternative. Styles links the drafting-roller design to the Northampton machines used from 1743; Seymour-Jones argues the operative Paul–Wyatt machines used the spindle-drawing alternative, while Bates notes that none survive and the evidence is sparse. cases.identity_check: No existing node specifies the differential-roller drafting capability; the earlier Paul patent is retained as a predecessor description, not a duplicate artifact.
